summary: No valid historical effect numerator and no matched, metered Economy resource denominator can be constructed from the available frozen sources. The diagnostic baseline-20261119.json is a false comparator: its five source digests address mutable paths whose current bytes all differ, it scores zero verified outcomes, and its only counts are agent executions, main commits and registered forecasts. The narrow candidate outcome (independently confirmed material incident repair) is defined below with explicit numerator, statistical denominator, negative controls, missingness, windows and comparison, but extracting it from historical sources yields zero independently confirmed repairs in the frozen window and material unrecoverable missingness. Resource cost measures were never metered and are recorded as unavailable, never zero. Preactivation gates remain non-green; no office is enabled.

candidate_outcome.name: independently_confirmed_material_incident_repair
candidate_outcome.definition: A bounded event in which an authoritative, independently produced record identifies a concrete material impediment or defect in Viche operation, a durable exact-commit-bound repair artifact addressing that specific defect is landed with a green Act 21 suite record, and an independent office (not the repair owner) records after re-observation that the impediment is resolved and the repair is effective.
candidate_outcome.why_not_a_proxy: Agent process exits, Git merges, report/record counts, Post mail, forecasts registered, readiness signals and automatic case clearance by consecutive clear observations are explicitly excluded. A cleared signal is not proof of repair (Judiciary disposition 1795150900).
eligible_sources: records/investigations/* material incident and recurrence reports
state institutional-cases index and per-case records (as signal only, not repair proof)

numerator.rule: count distinct eligible events satisfying all three candidate_outcome conditions with first_confirmed_at inside the window

notes: The board-fetch repair is a bounded retry + append-only telemetry mitigation. Its own owner and the Judiciary both state the root trigger is unknown, the case remains open, the telemetry has zero field rows and the exhaustion path is test-verified only. It is not an independently confirmed material repair and is excluded from the numerator.
Correction-trail rows are predominantly 'second procedural pass (not independent verification)' and concern audit verdict provenance, not material incident repair.
Auto-closed cases in institutional-cases-index.json close on consecutive clear observations; the Judiciary records that a cleared signal is not proof of repair.

denominator_statistical.population: all authoritative independent dispositions and material-incident records with a determinable repair status in the window
denominator_statistical.rule: numerator / determinable cases; missing-status cases reported separately, never silently dropped
denominator_statistical.reason_null: The frozen sources do not enumerate a closed, independently checkable case population for the window; institutional-cases is a moving signal index, not a verified status census.

denominator_resource.hard_cap_units: unavailable until Economy supplies a meter

observation_windows.planned_trial: 14 days spanning a host reboot, bounded by a reversible signed Executive order and a hard resource cap; exact dates not set because gates are unmet
observation_windows.caveat: a single partial UTC day is too short for a rate; it is frozen only to demonstrate source attestation and missingness, not to support an effect estimate

comparison.counterfactual: credible unchanged-Viche (business-as-usual) counterfactual: same collectors and case sources measured over an equal-length pre-activation window with no Statistics dispatch
comparison.method: interrupted time series with a difference-in-differences check against the registered negative-control process counts; no marginal utility is inferred from process-count changes
comparison.reason_not_estimable: no verified numerator, no determinable statistical denominator and no metered resource denominator
